text: The puppy ate one of my work shoes 😩
[photo: brown leather derby, toe chewed off, foam showing through]
The only pair I have for the Monday meeting jaja
Not sure it can be saved
No!! 😭 was it left in the hallway?
Yes. I left both by the door last night like an idiot
Now it's asleep next to my bed like nothing happened
Can you do a meeting in the sneakers?
Client is a bank 💀
Ok so no
There's a zapatero near Irarrázaval, the old guy with the glasses. He fixed my boots once, it was a miracle
Which one is that, the one by the metro?
No, the one past the pharmacy. The sign is half falling off
Ok going today before he closes
Just got off break. He's going to be fine, I think the puppy just wanted to be part of the outfit
😂 it's not funny
It's a little funny
[photo: the derby on a wooden counter, a man in a gray cardigan holding a sole up to the light]
He says maybe. Toe can be rebuilt, leather is ok. Monday or Tuesday
Cost me 18,000 which is less than I thought
Good, a win. You owe the puppy a treat though 🐶
He's getting a cheese stick tonight, I'm not a monster
